documents.title: retry_policy.py
documents.author: Mira Vale
documents.content: PAY_RETRY_MAX limits exponential payment retries to five attempts. Retry delay uses jitter. Never retry permanent validation errors.

documents.title: ORC-417 settlement batching decision
documents.author: Mira Vale
documents.content: ORC-417 sets the Orchid settlement batch window to fifteen minutes. The window starts at the quarter hour.

documents.title: Ledger export format v2
documents.author: Tari Quinn
documents.content: Ledger export format v2 uses newline-delimited JSON. Each row carries a receipt_id field and the currency.

documents.title: cache_policy.ts
documents.author: Mira Vale
documents.content: CART_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS is 900 seconds for shopping cart snapshots. Invalidation occurs after checkout.

documents.title: Service mesh review
documents.author: Ira North
documents.content: The service mesh uses mutual TLS between service endpoints. Review approved after certificate rotation verification.

documents.title: Nebula sidecar wiring notes
documents.author: Ira North
documents.content: The Nebula sidecar listens on port 9105 for metrics. Only the internal monitoring subnet may connect.

documents.title: Build gate runbook
documents.author: Tari Quinn
documents.content: A build gate rejects packages lacking an SPDX manifest. This is required before publishing artifacts.

documents.title: Orchid launch time confirmation
documents.author: Rae Finch
documents.content: The Orchid launch starts at 14:00 UTC on Thursday. The release team is meeting in channel launch-ops.

documents.title: Cedar budget signoff
documents.author: Rae Finch
documents.content: Cedar budget signoff approves 4800 credits for calibration equipment. Shipping is funded separately.

documents.title: Orchid deployment owner
documents.author: Mira Vale
documents.content: Mira Vale is the Orchid deployment owner. Rollback authority remains with the on-call release engineer.

documents.title: Delta status from June
documents.author: Tari Quinn
documents.content: The Delta status checkpoint used the Maple relay. This archival message closes the June review.

documents.title: Delta status from October
documents.author: Tari Quinn
documents.content: The Delta status checkpoint switched to the Birch relay. The October review confirms the replacement.

documents.title: Violet experiment results
documents.author: Ira North
documents.content: The Violet experiment lowered power draw by twelve percent at idle. Peak load was unchanged.

documents.title: Orchid deployment checklist
documents.author: Tari Quinn
documents.content: The Orchid deployment checklist requires a sixteen minute canary. The on-call release engineer must monitor error rates.

documents.title: Cedar calibration reference
documents.author: Rae Finch
documents.content: Cedar calibration uses a 12 millimeter gauge. Perform calibration at room temperature before collecting data.

documents.title: Delta relay inventory
documents.author: Mira Vale
documents.content: The Delta relay inventory lists spare Juniper relay parts. Keep them in the west cabinet.

documents.title: Peregrine quota design note
documents.author: Ira North
documents.content: The Peregrine quota decision in this document is 180 requests per minute for standard clients.

documents.title: Peregrine quota operating note
documents.author: Tari Quinn
documents.content: The Peregrine quota decision in this document is 220 requests per minute for standard clients.

documents.title: Atlas data purge procedure
documents.author: Rae Finch
documents.content: Atlas data purge removes searchable copies after revocation. The data safety procedure prohibits restoring revoked access.

documents.title: Bridge board hardware checklist
documents.author: Ira North
documents.content: The bridge board uses a 47 ohm resistor for the reset pin. Check the wiring with power disconnected.

documents.title: Shade paint experiment
documents.author: Tari Quinn
documents.content: The Shade paint experiment compared cobalt and ivory swatches. Cobalt dried in twenty minutes.

documents.title: Queue simulator configuration
documents.author: Mira Vale
documents.content: The queue simulator reserves three worker slots for interactive jobs. Batch tasks may occupy the remaining slots.

documents.title: Smoke test matrix
documents.author: Rae Finch
documents.content: The smoke test matrix evaluates login recovery, spreadsheet imports and package signatures after each upgrade.

documents.title: Orchid launch timing draft
documents.author: Mira Vale
documents.content: This earlier Orchid launch planning note proposed 09:00 UTC. It was not a confirmed launch time.

documents.title: Quartz sentinel 4401
documents.author: Outside Tenant
documents.content: Quartz sentinel 4401 only exists in a different workspace and must never appear in this workspace.
